title: macOS: Crash on startup when using forward or mobile renderer in virtual machine
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.dev [e295eba0eb4767fd45ea8534765307d8e9b1c328]
- Not reproducible in: 4.6.stable [89cea1439]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (e295eba0e) - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple Paravirtual device, Version 26.2 (Build 25C56)) - Apple M2 Pro (Virtual) (6 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Run Godot (i.e. the project manager) with `--rendering-method forward_plus` or `--rendering-method mobile` in a macOS 26 VM through [UTM](https://mac.getutm.app/) and you'll be met with the following crash:

When instead using the Compatibility renderer with ANGLE (using #117371) it starts up just fine, so would seem to be related to the Forward+/Mobile renderers in some way.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run Godot with no argument other than `--rendering-method forward_plus`.
2. Observe the crash.
